name: comment-banner
description: Turn the current line into an aligned banner comment, e.g. // ─── Generic strings ───────────────────

commands.title: Comment Banner: Insert / Update Banner on Current Line

commentBanner.lineLength.description: Target width for the banner in characters. 0 = auto (use editor.rulers[0] for the file, falling back to 80).

commentBanner.fillChar.description: Character used to fill the banner.

commentBanner.padding.description: Character(s) inserted around the label, e.g. '// ─── label ───'.

commentBanner.languageComments.description: Override or add comment styles per languageId, e.g. { "mylang": { "start": ";;", "end": "" } }.
